profiles.name: Desktop: Default
profiles.author: silvan
profiles.description: Four DPI stages (400/800/1600/2400) with per-zone lighting on the DPI strip and the logo. A sensible starting point for a G502 LIGHTSPEED.

profiles.name: Rocket League: Wheel as controller
profiles.author: silvan
profiles.description: Rocket League has no wheel support, so this profile turns on OpenGHub's gamepad mode: the G923 shows up as an Xbox 360 controller with steering on the left stick, accelerator and brake on the triggers, cross/circle/square/triangle as A/B/X/Y (jump, boost, powerslide, ball cam on the default bindings), paddles as the bumpers and Share/Options as Back/Start. The range is 360° with a firm 60% centering spring so the wheel behaves like a self-centering stick.
